author: Zdenek Dvorak
paper_scope: Independent paper reasoning assessed in notes.md; Python fixed-domain certificates do not formalize topology or arbitrary-size proof.

Corollary 8.B3_application: Private vertices of one terminal odd cycle, compared in the same literal row and root pair.
Corollary 8.conditions: Connected uncolorable degree assignment; adjacent noncut vertices have equal lists.

Lemma 7.B3_application: Same connected original C, exact lists from each legal G-C pair; all full C degrees are four.
Lemma 7.conditions: Connected graph; list sizes at least internal degrees; if any strict slack then list-colorable.

Theorem 10.B3_application: Applied to C for a rejected q and legal original G-C pair; no pinned-pair edge-minimality is assumed.
Theorem 10.conditions: Connected graph with degree assignment; uncolorability implies Gallai tree and blockwise uniform lists.

title: List coloring and Gallai trees
